title: 短对话的解题步骤
goal: 根据题干确定对象和信息类别，结合完整回应核对选项。

points.label: 根据题干确定所问信息及对象
用完整回应核对选项依据

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 短对话教学内容与课程小测规格

body.p: 题干规定问哪个人、问哪类信息。正确答案的人物、时间和动作都与题干一致。依据在说话人完整的回应里。

body.box:
Where will Lena meet Sam? → At the west entrance.
When will Lena meet Sam? → At three.

body.p: 同一次见面可以问地点，也可以问时间。west entrance 回答地点，three 回答时刻。

steps.d: 读题干中的姓名或身份，确定所问的人。What will Nina bring? 问 Nina 携带的物品。
疑问词和后面的词说明要听哪类信息。When does the class start? 问课程几点开始。
回应中常有否定和更改，听到句末再判断。I planned to walk, but I'll cycle instead 表示最后骑车。
把选项中的人物、动作和时间与回应逐一对照。Maya brings cups 不能回答 Leo 带什么。

cards.title: 题干与信息
rows: 地点
Where will Rosa meet Kai?
Rosa 与 Kai 约定的地点。
时间
When does the film begin?
电影开始的时刻。
人物关系
How are the speakers related?
由双方的职责或称呼判断的关系。
意图
Why does Omar mention the rain?
Omar 提到下雨的目的。
行动
What will Mei do next?
Mei 已确定的下一步行动。

cards.title: 完整回应
rows: I thought of Monday, but Tuesday is better.
最后定在周二。
but 后面是改过的选择。
I can't collect it; Ana will do that.
由 Ana 去取。
can't 说明说话人不取，will 说明 Ana 去取。
We met at noon yesterday; let's meet at two today.
今天约在两点。
today 说明这是今天的安排。
The blue folder is mine, and the green one is Jo's.
绿色文件夹是 Jo 的。
and 后面说的是绿色文件夹。

body.box:
A: Leo, are you bringing the plates for the garden lunch?
B: I can bring cups. Nina has already offered to bring the plates.
A: Good. I'll bring the food.

What will Leo bring?
1. The food.
2. The plates.
3. The cups.
4. The plates and the cups.

body.p: 题干问 Leo 带什么。Leo 说 I can bring cups，即第三项。plates 由 Nina 带。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 答非所问
When? → At the west entrance.
题干问时间，地点不能作答。
换人
Leo brings cups → Nina brings cups
cups 是 Leo 带的，Nina 带的是 plates。
换时间
Yesterday at noon → today at noon
noon 是昨天的时间，今天约在两点。
忽略修正
Monday, but Tuesday is better → Monday
以 but 后面的安排为准。

lines.text: Mila, I can take the flowers to the hall this morning. Are you bringing the paper decorations, or will you collect the food?
I'll bring the decorations. Arun is collecting the food after lunch.

items.why: Mila 回答 I'll bring the decorations，即第二项。food 由 Arun 去取。

lines.text: The pottery class used to start at six, didn't it? I have a meeting until then, so I may arrive late today.
It did last month, but today it starts at seven. There's plenty of time after your meeting.

items.stem: When does the pottery class start today?
items.why: It did last month, but today it starts at seven 说明今天七点开课，即第四项。六点是上个月的时间。

lines.text: Dr Green, my essay is almost ready, but could I hand it in after the history lesson tomorrow? I need to check one reference tonight.
Certainly, Ella. Put it on my desk before lunch.

items.why: Ella 请求晚一点交 essay，Dr Green 让她放到自己桌上。两人是学生和老师，即第一项。

lines.text: Shall we put the display near the window? The front entrance has more light, but people might block the doorway.
Let's use the window. I'll move the chairs away so everyone can see it.

items.stem: Where will the speakers put the display?
items.why: Let's use the window 是最后的决定，展品放在窗边，即第三项。

lines.text: Dina, will you pick up the paint for the community mural? I can collect the brushes after I finish work at the garden.
Yes, I'll get the paint this afternoon. The brushes are already at the community center.

items.why: Dina 回答 I'll get the paint，即第一项。brushes 已经在社区中心。

lines.text: Is the photography workshop still on Thursday? I reserved a camera for that day, although I could change the booking if needed.
The instructor moved it to Friday, so the camera booking needs to change.

items.why: The instructor moved it to Friday 说明改到了周五，即第二项。

lines.text: Excuse me, I'd like to reserve a table for four this evening. Is there a quiet space away from the entrance?
Certainly. I can book a table beside the window for seven.

items.stem: How are the speakers most likely related?
options: Two diners waiting by the entrance
A diner and a restaurant worker
items.why: 一方要 reserve a table，另一方说 I can book a table，是在为客人订位，即第三项。

lines.text: I'd planned to send the pictures by email tonight, but my connection has stopped working. Can you send them from your office?
Yes. Give me the files and I'll email them after lunch.

items.stem: What will the second speaker do?
items.why: I'll email them after lunch 说明第二位说话者午饭后发图片，即第四项。tonight 是第一位说话者原来的计划。

lines.text: Could we meet by the fountain before the outdoor concert? I know you suggested the gate, but it will be crowded there.
All right. I'll wait by the fountain with the tickets.

items.why: I'll wait by the fountain 接受了在喷泉旁见面的提议，即第一项。gate 是原来的建议。

lines.text: The forecast says rain this afternoon, and the picnic blankets are still outside. Could someone bring them in before lunch?
I'll bring them inside now, and then I'll prepare the food for the picnic.

items.stem: Why does the first speaker mention the rain?
options: To suggest moving the picnic inside
items.why: 提到下雨后，说话者问 Could someone bring them in，目的是请人把毯子收进来，即第二项。
